header.title: Multi-User Testing
header.description: Run a test with several browser sessions at the same time. This is useful for collaborative features, user interactions, and scenarios that need more than one active user.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Multi-user tests use the users array and the tasks function instead of the single task field. The framework detects multi-user tests automatically and creates a separate browser session for each user.

basicStructure.title: Basic Multi-User Test Structure
basicStructure.description: Define the users, then return one task per user from the tasks function.

automaticDetection.title: Automatic Detection
items: The framework automatically detects tests with a users array and a tasks function
No CLI changes are needed. Use the existing run command
Backward compatible with single-user tests

browserSessions.title: Multiple Browser Sessions
items: Each user gets their own browser context and page
Sessions run in parallel for better performance
Maximum 5 users per test to prevent resource exhaustion

userTasks.title: User-Specific Tasks
items: The tasks function returns user-specific task instructions
Each user can have a different workflow
Tasks run simultaneously across all users

utilities.description: These helpers are exported from endorphin-ai.

utilities.getUserIds: Get all user IDs in the current test
utilities.isMultiUserMode: Check whether multi-user mode is active

dataGeneration.title: Data Generation for Multi-User Tests
dataGeneration.description: Return data for each user, plus any shared data, from the data function.

reporting.title: Test Results and Reporting
reporting.description: Multi-user tests generate detailed reports showing:
items: Overall test success or failure
Per-user results and status
Individual user task execution details
Combined token usage and cost tracking
User-specific screenshots and logs

userNaming.title: User Naming
items: Use descriptive user names: 'admin', 'customer', 'moderator'
Keep names short and clear
Avoid special characters

taskDesign.title: Task Design
items: Make tasks independent when possible
Use the setup function for common initialization
Consider user interaction timing

dataManagement.title: Data Management
items: Structure data by user in the data function
Use user IDs as keys for user-specific data
Share common data across users

errorHandling.title: Error Handling
items: The test fails if any user fails
Individual user errors are tracked
Use descriptive error messages

limitations.title: Limitations
items: Maximum 5 users per test
All users must complete successfully for the test to pass
Browser resources scale with the number of users
Parallel execution may affect system performance

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: Common issues and how to fix them

pageNotFound.title: "User page not found"
solutions: Ensure the user ID exists in the users array
Check that multi-user mode is properly initialized

noTask.title: "No task found for user"
solutions: Verify that the tasks function returns tasks for all users
Check that the user ID spelling matches exactly

resources.title: Resource exhaustion
solutions: Consider running users sequentially instead of in parallel
